title: UPME: An Unsupervised Peer Review Framework for Multimodal Large Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the evaluating model's disproportionate preference for longer text responses by tracking incorrect selections of verbose answers and quantifying the bias using Chi-Square tests, p-values, and Phi Coefficients.
Measuring how often an evaluating model incorrectly prefers its own generated responses over those of other models, quantified using Chi-Square tests, p-values, and Phi Coefficients.
